description_en: Queries the information about an Spark application
kebab_example: aliyun adb get-spark-app-info --app-id s202205201533hz12098920000000 --db-cluster-id am-bp11q28kvl6880000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSparkAppInfo
